info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Internal Contacts API

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

params.name: showFederated
params.description: If `true` then contacts of all accounts in federation are returned. If `false` then only contacts of the current account are returned, and account section is eliminated in this case

params.name: type
params.description: Type of an extension. Please note that legacy 'Department' extension type corresponds to 'Call Queue' extensions in modern RingCentral product terminology

params.name: perPage
params.description:
Records count to be returned per one page. It can be either integer or string with the specific keyword values:
- `all` - all records are returned in one page
- `max` - maximum count of records that can be returned in one page

params.name: siteId
params.description: Internal identifier of the business site to which extensions belong

items.docs: Returns contact information on corporate users of federated accounts. Please note: 1. `User`, `DigitalUser`, `VirtualUser` and `FaxUser` types are returned as `User` type. 2. `ApplicationExtension` type is not returned. 3. Only extensions in `Enabled`, `Disabled` and `NotActivated` state are returned.
